instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: His age is of little significance.
Once their boss caught wind of Cherry’s plan to resign, she fired them cold-heartedly.
atoms.b: Once their boss caught wind of Cherry’s plan to ((resign)), she fired them cold-heartedly.

atoms.a: Bryan asked to receive his receipt by email.
atoms.b: Bryan asked to receive his ((receipt)) by email.

atoms.a: If you are distracted and don’t follow the recipe precisely, you’ll probably end up with a sad cake.
atoms.b: If you are distracted and don’t follow the ((recipe)) precisely, you’ll probably end up with a sad cake.

atoms.a: Until examining his new globe, Tom wasn’t aware of the existence of the geographic coordinate system.
atoms.b: Until examining his new globe, Tom wasn’t aware of the ((existence)) of the geographic coordinate system.

atoms.a: With our new virtual reality goggles, he doesn’t have to visualise it anymore; he can actually see himself experiencing this success.
atoms.b: With our new virtual reality goggles, he doesn’t have to ((visualise)) it anymore; he can actually see himself experiencing this success.
